name: Carbon
where: Cut down any plant, tree or fungal growth with the mining beam; available on every planet.
hidden: Running out strands you, because it fuels the very tool you mine with. Always keep a buffer before exploring far from your ship.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Condensed Carbon
where: Refine Carbon 2:1 in any refiner, or mine the red crystal clusters dotted across planet surfaces.
hidden: Burns much longer per inventory slot than raw Carbon and feeds countless recipes, so keep a stack even though it barely sells. (Wert unsicher)
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Di-hydrogen
where: Mine the blue crystal formations scattered across every planet surface.
hidden: It fuels your launch thrusters; without it you cannot take off. Refine 5:1 into Di-hydrogen Jelly to store launch fuel compactly.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Ferrite Dust
where: Shoot any rocky boulder or terrain with the mining beam; found on practically every planet, moon and base.
hidden: It is the backbone of almost every build and craft. Never sell it; the few units it fetches are not worth the constant re-gathering.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Magnetised Ferrite
where: Refine Pure Ferrite together with a metal (Copper, Silver or Gold) in a refiner; occasionally found as surface deposits.
hidden: Only a handful of advanced parts need it, so make it on demand rather than hoarding and clogging inventory slots.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Oxygen
where: Harvest red-flagged plants on almost any planet, or buy it cheaply at most trade terminals.
hidden: It doubles as a refiner catalyst: feeding Oxygen into many recipes multiplies the output, so it is worth far more than its sell price suggests.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Pure Ferrite
where: Refine Ferrite Dust 1:1 in any refiner; also sold at construction and trade terminals.
hidden: You rarely need to mine for it: surplus Ferrite Dust converts for free in the refiner while you get on with other things.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Sodium
where: Harvest yellow-flagged plants, or grab the glowing yellow crystals on cliffs and in caves.
hidden: Recharges hazard protection instantly, even mid-storm; a cheap lifesaver beginners often ignore in favour of running for shelter.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Sodium Nitrate
where: Refine Sodium 2:1, or mine it directly as a deposit on some planets.
hidden: Restores far more protection per unit than raw Sodium, so refine a stack before heading to extreme-weather worlds.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Tritium
where: Shoot asteroids from your starship; interstellar belts are full of it. Watch for 'Tritium-Rich' asteroids and Hyperclusters (~100 each).
hidden: It refuels the pulse engine directly with no crafting. Outlaw stations always stock some, handy when an asteroid belt is far away.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Nitrogen
where: Build a Gas Extractor on a Nitrogen gas hotspot (locate one with the survey device), usually on Lush or Toxic worlds; also via Atmosphere Harvesters.
hidden: Cheap raw, but combined with Condensed Carbon it makes Nitrogen Salt, a step toward commodities worth hundreds of thousands. Keep it for crafting, not selling. (Werte unsicher)
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Radon
where: Gas Extractor on a Radon hotspot, found on Irradiated and Frozen worlds; also via Atmosphere Harvesters.
hidden: Turns into Enriched Carbon with Condensed Carbon; an automated extractor makes it near-free passive income. (Werte unsicher)
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Sulphurine
where: Gas Extractor on a Sulphurine hotspot, found on Scorched, Desert and Volcanic worlds.
hidden: Feeds the Thermic Condensate chain; a passive Gas Extractor farm quietly stockpiles it while you play elsewhere. (Werte unsicher)
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Ammonia
where: Dig the marked deposit nodes on Toxic planets with the terrain tool.
hidden: A key link in the very lucrative Stasis Device chain, so stock up on toxic worlds, which only appear occasionally in some regions.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Chlorine
where: Mine underwater crystal growths, or refine it from Salt.
hidden: Chlorine + Oxygen in a refiner yields MORE Chlorine than you put in. Loop it with cheap station-bought Oxygen to print millions. (Werte unsicher)
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Cobalt
where: Mine the glowing deposits inside caves on most planets; guaranteed in quantity on irradiated worlds.
hidden: Caves keep you safe from surface hazards, so you can farm Cobalt for ages. Refine it to Ionised Cobalt for a free value bump before selling.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Dioxite
uses: Crafting Cryogenic Chamber and cold-weather tech
where: Mine deposits on Frozen/icy planets.
hidden: Frozen-world locked; station traders sometimes sell it, but it is far easier to stock up whenever you land on snow.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Ionised Cobalt
uses: Ion Battery & Advanced Ion Battery crafting
where: Refine Cobalt 1:1, or buy Cobalt cheaply and refine it in bulk.
hidden: Crafting it into Ion Batteries multiplies its value again; a single Cobalt-rich cave becomes a tidy income stream this way.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Paraffinium
where: Harvest the yellow-flowering plants on Lush and warm worlds, or mine surface deposits.
hidden: Frequently needed for base parts; if your home planet lacks it, keep a supply from a lush world rather than hunting for it mid-build.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Phosphorus
where: Dig the marked deposit nodes on Scorched/fiery planets with the terrain tool.
hidden: Locked to hot worlds, so grab a stack whenever you visit one; a recipe needing it can catch you out far from a scorched system. (unsicher: Biom-Verteilung variiert je Update)
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Pyrite
where: Mine deposits on desert and scorched worlds, or refine Gold together with Oxygen.
hidden: You can manufacture it in a refiner from Gold + Oxygen when no desert world is nearby, which beginners rarely realise.
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Salt
where: Mine the bright deposits on ocean worlds and some dead/barren planets; check coasts and the seabed.
hidden: The entry point to the Chlorine money loop: refine Salt to Chlorine, then multiply Chlorine with Oxygen for huge profit. (Werte unsicher)
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04

name: Uranium
uses: Crafting Health Station, Megawatt Heater, Radiation Deflector, etc.
where: Mine Uranium deposits on Irradiated (green/yellow) worlds with the terrain tool; sometimes inside metal 'fingers'.
hidden: It can fuel launch thrusters as a cheap alternative to Di-hydrogen and feeds many early base/tech recipes, so don't dump it. (Werte unsicher)
source: Paraphrased from NMS community wikis & guides, 2026-06-04
